subject.title: [Bug]: Skill Workshop agent-tool apply times out because approval wait exceeds tool watchdog

question: Which open linked PR should be the canonical security-reviewed fix for Skill Workshop lifecycle approvals timing out behind the Codex dynamic-tool watchdog?
rationale: The observable bug is source-reproducible, but the remaining choice changes approval timing and error semantics in a security-sensitive lifecycle path, and two open closing PRs solve it at different layers.

options.title: Use PR 100498 as canonical
options.body: Land the broader Skill Workshop approval-layer fix if its security review passes, then close this issue and supersede the older narrow timeout PR.

options.title: Use PR 91325 as the narrow fix
options.body: Land only the Codex timeout extension if maintainers want the smallest behavior change and leave popup metadata/timeout semantics to separate issues.

options.title: Hold for approval-flow redesign
options.body: Keep both PRs paused if maintainers want a different owner-approval model before changing lifecycle approval timing.

recommendation.title: Use PR 100498 as canonical
recommendation.body: Land the broader Skill Workshop approval-layer fix if its security review passes, then close this issue and supersede the older narrow timeout PR.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the current assignee and author of the broader open closing PR that now covers this issue and related Skill Workshop approval reports.
